name: Station battery discharge-current measurement
aliases: substations Station battery and charger distribution
summary: Identifies the measured battery discharge contribution to the station DC load.
description: Identifies the measured battery discharge contribution to the station DC load. A station battery system supplies protection, control and other assigned DC loads through a documented charger and distribution arrangement. Charger output, battery contribution and load distribution are related but separately monitored paths.

In a substation control building, the battery can support breaker trip circuits while the charger AC supply is unavailable. Supervision must identify whether the charger, battery or a downstream feeder is affected. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Battery current sensor” at the input and “Discharge-current information” at the output. Sensor polarity determines charge versus discharge sign.
